4. Option A correctly represents these dimensions.

Therefore, option (A) is the correct answer.

questionText:
Arrange the following electrodes in increasing order of strength as an oxidizing agent.

(A) $\mathrm{Ni^{2+} + 2e^- \rightarrow Ni(s)},\; E^0 = -0.25\text{ V}$
(B) $\mathrm{Cu^{2+} + 2e^- \rightarrow Cu(s)},\; E^0 = 0.34\text{ V}$
(C) $\mathrm{Br_2 + 2e^- \rightarrow 2Br^-},\; E^0 = 1.09\text{ V}$
(D) $\mathrm{O_2(g) + 2H^+ + 2e^- \rightarrow H_2O_2},\; E^0 = 0.68\text{ V}$

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
